nodes.name: audio_manager.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements the XAudio2/X3DAudio singleton: WAV load, 2D/3D playback, bus volumes, GameObject-tracked emitters, and instance voices used by audio components.
nodes.languageNotes: XAudio2 mastering voice plus X3DAudio listener/emitter DSP; named clips live beside numeric AudioPlaybackId instances.

nodes.name: audio_manager.h
nodes.summary: Declares AudioManager, AudioType, and the public load/play/stop/volume API for 2D, 3D, instance, and UI-click playback.
nodes.languageNotes: C++ singleton with deleted copy operations; private helpers operate on an internal Playback voice struct.

nodes.name: debug_system.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements main-thread debug controls: collision visualization, time-scale cycling, freeze frame-step, hitstop pulses, and the on-screen overlay.

nodes.name: Initialize
nodes.summary: Creates the XAudio2 engine, mastering voice, and X3DAudio handle.

nodes.name: Clamp01
nodes.summary: Clamps a scalar volume or mix value into the 0–1 range.

nodes.name: DestroyPlaybackVoice
nodes.summary: Stops and destroys an XAudio2 source voice on a Playback.

nodes.name: VoiceHasFinished
nodes.summary: Returns whether a non-looping source voice has drained.

nodes.name: Finalize
nodes.summary: Stops every voice and tears down XAudio2 resources.

nodes.name: Update
nodes.summary: Ticks 3D emitters, listener tracking, finished-instance sweep, and debug draw.

nodes.name: LoadWav
nodes.summary: Reads a WAV file into Playback audio bytes and WAVEFORMATEX.

nodes.name: PlaySFX3D
nodes.summary: Starts or restarts a named 3D SFX at a world position.

nodes.name: PlaySFX
nodes.summary: Starts or restarts a named 2D sound-effect clip.

nodes.name: PlayBGM
nodes.summary: Starts or restarts looping background music by id or path.

nodes.name: PlayVoice
nodes.summary: Starts or restarts a named voice-over clip.

nodes.name: LoadBGM
nodes.summary: Preloads a BGM WAV without starting playback.

nodes.name: LoadSFX
nodes.summary: Preloads a 2D SFX WAV without starting playback.

nodes.name: LoadVoice
nodes.summary: Preloads a voice WAV without starting playback.

nodes.name: Load3DSFX
nodes.summary: Preloads a 3D SFX and prepares its emitter.

nodes.name: Apply3DAudio
nodes.summary: Runs X3DAudio and applies the output matrix to a 3D voice.

nodes.name: Stop
nodes.summary: Stops and releases the named playback id.

nodes.name: StopAll
nodes.summary: Stops every named source currently playing.

nodes.name: StopAllByType
nodes.summary: Stops all voices of BGM, SFX, or VOICE type.

nodes.name: IsPlaying
nodes.summary: Reports whether the named source still has an active voice.

nodes.name: SetEmitterPosition
nodes.summary: Moves a 3D source emitter to a world position.

nodes.name: SetEmitterDistanceScale
nodes.summary: Sets how quickly a 3D source attenuates with distance.

nodes.name: SetEmitter
nodes.summary: Binds a 3D source emitter to a GameObject transform.

nodes.name: SetListenerStereoBalance
nodes.summary: Toggles listener stereo-balance processing.

nodes.name: SetListener
nodes.summary: Sets the 3D listener from an explicit pose or a tracked GameObject.

nodes.name: OnGameObjectDestroyed
nodes.summary: Clears listener/emitter pointers that referenced a freed GameObject.

nodes.name: SetVolume
nodes.summary: Sets per-source base volume and reapplies bus mix.

nodes.name: UpdateVolume
nodes.summary: Writes the combined bus volume onto a source voice.

nodes.name: ReapplyAllVolumes
nodes.summary: Recomputes output volume for every live source.

nodes.name: SetMasterVolume
nodes.summary: Sets master bus volume and reapplies all voices.

nodes.name: SetBGMVolume
nodes.summary: Sets the BGM bus volume.

nodes.name: SetSFXVolume
nodes.summary: Sets the SFX bus volume.

nodes.name: SetVoiceVolume
nodes.summary: Sets the voice-over bus volume.

nodes.name: DrawDebug
nodes.summary: Draws 3D emitter spheres through DebugDrawer when debug draw is on.

nodes.name: GetDebugInfo
nodes.summary: Returns distance and L/R matrix volumes for a 3D source.

nodes.name: Setup3DEmitter
nodes.summary: Initializes X3DAudio emitter fields and distance curve.

nodes.name: SubmitAndStart
nodes.summary: Submits the WAV buffer and starts the source voice.

nodes.name: SweepFinishedInstances
nodes.summary: Destroys instance voices that have finished playing.

nodes.name: StartInstance
nodes.summary: Allocates a unique AudioPlaybackId and starts a component-owned voice.

nodes.name: StartInstanceFromLoaded
nodes.summary: Starts an instance from a previously loaded named clip.

nodes.name: SetUiClickSound
nodes.summary: Preloads the 2D SFX used by UI button clicks.

nodes.name: PlayUiClick
nodes.summary: Plays the preloaded UI click SFX.

nodes.name: StopInstance
nodes.summary: Stops one component-owned playback id.

nodes.name: IsInstancePlaying
nodes.summary: Returns whether an instance id still has an active voice.

nodes.name: SetInstancePosition
nodes.summary: Updates a 3D instance emitter position.

nodes.name: SetInstanceDistanceScale
nodes.summary: Updates attenuation scale for an instance voice.

nodes.name: SetInstanceVolume
nodes.summary: Updates volume on an instance voice.

nodes.name: StopAllInstances
nodes.summary: Stops every component-owned instance voice.

nodes.name: StopSceneInstances
nodes.summary: Stops scene instances while leaving persistAcrossScene voices running.

nodes.name: LoadBusVolumesFromProjectFile
nodes.summary: Reads master/BGM/SFX/voice bus levels from project.json.

nodes.name: TryLoadBusVolumesFromNearbyProject
nodes.summary: Looks for a nearby project.json and loads bus volumes.

nodes.name: Playback
nodes.summary: Internal voice record holding WAV bytes, an XAudio2 source voice, and optional X3DAudio emitter state.

nodes.name: ClearPulse
nodes.summary: Cancels any in-flight time-scale pulse.

nodes.name: ApplyFreezeCursor
nodes.summary: Shows or restores the third-person camera cursor when entering or leaving freeze.

nodes.name: Init
nodes.summary: Resets debug overlay, time scale, and collision-viz state.

nodes.name: Shutdown
nodes.summary: Clears overlay text and restores cursor ownership.

nodes.name: ToggleCollisionViz
nodes.summary: Toggles F11 collider wireframe visualization.

nodes.name: CollisionVizEnabled
nodes.summary: Returns whether collider debug draw is enabled.

nodes.name: GetTimeScale
nodes.summary: Returns the effective time scale including an active pulse.

nodes.name: PulseTimeScale
nodes.summary: Starts a short real-time hitstop pulse unless debug time-scale is already overridden.

nodes.name: UpdateTimeScalePulse
nodes.summary: Advances pulse remaining time using unscaled wall-clock delta.

nodes.name: CycleTimeScale
nodes.summary: Cycles debug time scale 1 → 0.5 → 0.25 → freeze → 1.

nodes.name: IsFrozen
nodes.summary: True when the effective time scale is zero.

nodes.name: StepOneFrame
nodes.summary: Requests a single Update tick while the world is frozen.

nodes.name: FrameStepRequested
nodes.summary: Returns whether a freeze frame-step is pending.

nodes.name: StepAdvance
nodes.summary: Returns a 1/60 dt if a step is pending and clears the request.

nodes.name: ConsumeFrameStep
nodes.summary: Consumes a pending frame-step request and returns whether one was waiting.

nodes.name: SetOverlayText
nodes.summary: Replaces the debug overlay string.

nodes.name: GetOverlayColor
nodes.summary: Returns overlay tint (red while frozen).

nodes.name: RefreshOverlay
nodes.summary: Rebuilds overlay lines from time scale, freeze, and physics debug stats.

nodes.name: ResetTimeScale
nodes.summary: Clears freeze, pulses, and debug time-scale when play ends.

nodes.name: TimeScalePulseState
nodes.summary: Tracks an active hitstop-style time-scale pulse and remaining real-time duration.
